job: Add a curated open-source skills and projects collection to the existing personal portfolio, with repository and public page links
primaryTask: Distinguish reusable skill files from working projects, then reach the source repository or public evidence page.

productPrecedent.name: Existing portfolio project collection
divergences: compact cards replace long case-study anatomy because the job is source discovery
kind filters appear only on the dedicated index

defects.problem: Visitors cannot distinguish reusable agent skill files from project implementations or open a skill file directly.
defects.evidence: The existing portfolio mixes products, infrastructure, strategy, and enterprise delivery; it has no skill-file object or skill/project control.
defects.expectedEffect: Add explicit Skill file and Project labels, direct source actions, and a working kind filter.

defects.problem: Repository links and public evidence pages are duplicated across hand-authored HTML with no authoritative publication record.
defects.evidence: GitHub URLs occur across portfolio, case-study, writing, and voice pages; there is no data registry or generated-surface check.
defects.expectedEffect: Generate both the portfolio section and index from one explicit allowlist and fail CI when generated output drifts.

defects.problem: The 24 long-form portfolio entries bury the small set of source-inspectable work.
defects.evidence: The source links appear inside multi-screen project articles and are not available as a scannable collection.
defects.expectedEffect: Place a compact proof-led collection before the long-form case studies and provide a dedicated index.

defects.problem: Making every GitHub-public repository visible would turn a hosting setting into editorial publication consent.
defects.evidence: The account currently has more public repositories than are intentionally represented on the site.
defects.expectedEffect: Default exposure to private and render only explicitly allowlisted public records.
